atAGlance: Cá nướng muối ớt is salt-chili grilled fish, usually with charred skin, chili-salt rub, herbs, lime, and a dipping salt or fish-sauce dip.
whatItIs: Cá nướng muối ớt is fish grilled with a chili-salt crust, usually served whole or in large pieces with herbs, lime, and a dipping salt or fish-sauce dip.
howToEnjoy: Share the fish, flake meat carefully from the bones, and use herbs, lime, and dipping salt lightly so the smoke and chili-salt crust stay clear. If rice paper is served, wrap small fish pieces with herbs.
howLocalsOrder: Order cá nướng muối ớt as a shared grilled fish. Ask whether it comes whole, whether bones remain, and for less chili before the salt-chili rub goes on.
worthKnowing: At Vietnamese seafood shops, this order is about smoke and chili-salt crust; rice paper and herbs may turn it into a wrap-and-share meal if they come with the fish.
goodToKnow: Ask for less spicy if heat is a concern.
travelerCaution: Ask for less spicy if heat is a concern.
